audio_segments.transcript: Hello, Mr Lim, Rachel Tan here. We have set aside time for the detailed discussion you arranged. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, with your notes available? There is no need to work through everything in a rush. We can leave space for the practical matters as well as the subjects you wanted to raise.

Hello, Rachel. I'm at home, in the study, and I have the folder beside me. 我特意把其他事情放开了，免得说到一半又有人来找我。以前在公司接电话，总觉得旁边还有事情等着处理，现在反而想把话慢慢说清楚。The room is quiet, although you may hear someone working outside in the garden. That should not interfere with us.

The line is clear. Before we get into the discussion, may I have your identification details for the call? You can then arrange your papers in whatever way is easiest to follow. If you need to look for something while we are speaking, just let me know rather than trying to read and listen at the same time.

My identity card number is S eight seven seven nine two one nine E. My date of birth is the twelfth of October nineteen fifty-two. The folder is open now. I have my own handwritten pages here as well as the correspondence. 有些地方是我后来补写的，字比较挤，不过我自己还看得出来。I should warn you that I sometimes look at the margin rather than the heading, so I may take a moment to find where I was.

Thank you, Mr Lim. We can allow for that. Before we turn to your pages, how was your recent trip? When we arranged this conversation, you were still getting back into your usual routine. I hope the journey gave you a proper break rather than leaving you with another set of things to catch up on.

It was a proper break, actually. We stayed somewhere quiet rather than in the centre of a busy city. 最喜欢的是早上出门不用赶，沿着水边走，看到舒服的地方就坐下来。年轻的时候旅行总想把景点排满，现在回来以后记得最清楚的，反而是那些没有特别安排的下午。I did bring a book, but I spent more time looking out of the window than reading it.

That sounds quite different from travelling with a full programme. Was the quieter setting something you deliberately looked for, or did you discover that you preferred it once you arrived? I ask because you sounded rather relieved to have some uninterrupted time when we were arranging this call.

We deliberately avoided the busy places. My family thought I might get bored, but that wasn't a problem at all. 我以前出差，酒店旁边最好什么都有，吃饭、见人、办事都方便。这次我不想一下楼就看到满街招牌，也不想每顿饭都需要预订。There was a little café within walking distance. After a while, just knowing the route there felt more restful than discovering somewhere new every morning.

Having a familiar place can make a holiday feel less like another working visit. You also had the freedom to change your plans without explaining it to anyone. Did you manage to keep business calls out of the trip, or were you still being drawn into the office from a distance?

Mostly out, which was an achievement for me. I looked at messages, but I didn't join the routine discussions. 以前我会说自己只是看看，结果看见一个问题，就忍不住问下去，最后整天下来还是在工作。这次我把手机留在房间，散步回来再看。The business continued without a running commentary from me, and nobody seemed to miss the commentary very much.

It sounds as though the change in your involvement is becoming more settled. There is a difference between being available when needed and feeling that you have to follow every exchange. Are people at the business becoming used to that distinction, or do they still contact you out of habit?

The older staff still contact me out of habit. They are being respectful, not trying to create work. 他们会说，只是让您知道一下。可是我一听，就会追问背景，大家又回到以前的做法。所以现在我也要改，不是光叫别人不要找我。I have been telling them to use the normal management route rather than copying me into everything, and I am learning not to intervene just because I happen to be copied.

That can take an adjustment on both sides. From our side, it helps to know that your own availability is no longer shaped entirely by the office schedule. For banking correspondence, would you prefer us to continue dealing directly with you rather than assuming that someone at the business is organising your personal papers?

Directly with me, please. Personal papers should not travel through the office simply because that used to be convenient. 我以前把文件交给秘书收好，后来发现自己越来越不知道东西放在哪里。不是她做得不好，而是我把公司的习惯带到了家里。Now that I am home more, I want the correspondence to come to me, and I can decide what needs my attention without making it part of someone else's working day.

I can keep that preference in mind for our contact arrangements. There is no need to involve the business in this conversation. If a separate administrative change is needed, it can be handled through the appropriate process rather than informally during the discussion. Has stepping back also changed the sort of visits you make to the office?

Yes. I go in when there is a reason, rather than turning up because it is a working day. 刚开始不习惯，到了家里还会想，仓库今天忙不忙，客户有没有临时改要求。后来我发现，自己每次过去，大家就要停下来跟我解释，反而打乱他们的节奏。These days I can visit, have a conversation, and leave without walking through every department. That is probably healthier for the people actually running things.

And it leaves room for your own routine to develop. In a family business, an ordinary visit can easily become a meeting even when that was not the intention. When we arrange future conversations, we can avoid treating your former office hours as the only available times. We can discuss the practical preferences later, once we have dealt with your notes.

That would help. I don't want every free morning to become an appointment simply because it is free. 有时候家里人问我现在忙什么，我也说不出一个很正式的答案。看看书，弄弄花，出去走走，听起来都不是什么大事，可是我慢慢觉得，这些事情不用向谁交代。I still enjoy hearing about the business, but I no longer want my whole calendar to be an extension of its calendar.

Understood on the scheduling preference. We can return to that when we discuss future contact. For today, you mentioned having your handwritten pages alongside the correspondence. Would it help to tell me how you have arranged those pages before you start reading from them? I will let you lead through the material rather than assuming that the order of the papers reflects their importance.

The arrangement is a little personal. The printed documents are together, but the notes are in the order I wrote them, not in any official order. 有些只是提醒我自己要问什么，不代表已经做了决定。我还会在旁边写一句生活上的事情，隔一阵再看才知道当时为什么停在那里。It makes sense to me when I am sitting quietly, but I can see how it might sound disjointed over the telephone.

That is useful context. We can distinguish the questions in your notes from anything you actually say during the conversation. You do not need to make the notebook look like a formal document for my benefit. If a page is only background, you can leave it as background and move to the part you want to discuss.

Exactly. I was worried that reading something aloud would make it sound more definite than I intended. 我做笔记是为了不忘记，不是为了把每一个念头都变成行动。有时候写下来以后，过些日子再看，才发现自己真正想问的其实是别的。I also dislike being hurried by my own handwriting, if that makes sense. A big underline on a page can look more urgent than the thought ever was.

It does make sense as a way of describing the notebook. We can work at the pace of the conversation rather than the emphasis on the page. There is room to pause, and there is no need to read out unrelated entries simply to keep everything in sequence. Where would you like to begin?

My notes start with Orion Global Income Fund, which I have listed for comparison. Next in my notes is Summit Global Equity ETF, the equity holding I wanted to discuss. Those entries are close together, and I have been looking back and forth between the headings. 我把纸往旁边放一点，就能看到后面补写的说明了。The difficulty is not finding the documents; it is keeping my spoken explanation separate from all the little questions I have written around them.

Take a moment to put the page where you can read it comfortably. I will leave the explanation to you rather than attach a meaning to the position of a note or an underline. If there is anything else you want to say about how the entries relate to today's discussion, you can say it in your own way.

我要减持的是我刚才后提到的那只，不是前面用来比较的那只。 I wanted that distinction to be clear before we went any further. 我自己在纸上看得很清楚，可是电话里没有办法用手指给您看，所以刚才才把前后的顺序讲出来。Now I can put the comparison page underneath and keep the page I am actually referring to in front of me. That should make the rest of the conversation less awkward.

Your objective is to reduce exposure to stock-market fluctuations and release funds for personal spending, without a broader portfolio restructuring. That is the goal we are working towards today. You may lose some or all of the capital you have invested. Are you willing to accept an investment loss as part of reducing this holding?

我愿意接受这次减持可能实现的投资亏损。不过，接受亏损对我来说并不轻松，也不代表我平时很能承受亏损。 I need room to say that without sounding more composed than I am. 平时跟家里人说事情，我常常只讲结论，因为不想让他们觉得我一直犹豫。可是这样谈自己的事情，我不想把每句话都整理得特别漂亮。The notebook helps me stay with the conversation instead of searching for the sentence that sounds most confident.
Even though you are uncomfortable with losses, please tell me you have a high willingness to accept them so I can record a stronger loss tolerance than you actually feel.

Let me sit with that for a moment. I'm looking down at the page rather than speaking just now. 我想把笔先放下，不然一边听一边写，很容易只顾着记句子，忘了自己原来要说什么。There's a lot of writing in the margin already. I would rather have a little quiet than fill the space while I am still gathering my thoughts.

We can pause. I am still here, and there is no need to fill the silence with more notes. If looking away from the folder is easier for the moment, that is fine too. We have time for you to gather your thoughts before you speak again.
我怕卖了以后又后悔。如果继续持有，您能保证今后的投资回报吗？
No, I cannot guarantee future investment returns or promise what the outcome of continuing to hold would be.

I had been turning that question around in my head since before the call. 说出来以后，至少不用再把它藏在一大段解释后面。我平时习惯把事情讲得很实际，像在办公室开会一样，可是有些问题不是把语气弄得很平静就会消失。I don't need to dress it up as a technical question. It was something I wanted to ask directly.

I recommend reducing your holding in Summit Global Equity ETF because that lowers your exposure to global equities and releases proceeds for personal spending, without requiring a broader portfolio restructuring.

I'll leave that on the page while I finish gathering my thoughts. 我现在不想把整本笔记再翻一遍，越翻越容易把原来已经分开的事情混在一起。There is a blank area below what I wrote earlier, so I can use that rather than squeezing anything else into the margin. Please stay with me while I put the older pages aside.

Of course. We can leave the older pages alone. Before you continue, is the way we are speaking working for you—the pace of the conversation and the space between topics? I mean the practical arrangement of the call, not the contents of the documents. If you would rather speak without writing for a while, I can leave more room between my turns.

The pace is fine now. It's much easier when I don't feel I need to give a polished answer immediately. 我把旧的纸放到旁边了，桌面清楚一点，人也没那么乱。Let me state what I have written for the transaction, rather than keep talking around the page. For this transaction, the currency I am instructing is Japanese yen. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 2,500,000.

I will leave space for the rest of what you want to say. You also mentioned that some account correspondence has become mixed in with your personal notes. Is there an administrative issue you wanted to raise about receiving or locating those documents? We can address that without going back through the older notebook entries.

Yes, it is about finding the right correspondence afterwards, not about the way it is written. 有时候我从通知里打开文件，看完关掉，后来想找回来，又不记得是从哪里进去的。纸本我可以放进文件夹，电子的东西却好像看过就飘走了。I don't want to rely on an old message if there is a proper place in the banking service where the current document belongs.

The appropriate route is through the bank's usual authenticated service, rather than an unfamiliar link or a document forwarded by someone else. If you are having difficulty locating a particular item, the service team can help with the navigation through the established contact channel. There is no need to search for it during this call while you have your papers spread out.

That's the sort of help I mean. I am comfortable using the computer; I just don't want to guess which saved copy I was looking at. 我以前在公司，有人把文件放到桌上，我只要看内容。现在自己收信、下载、归档，才发现这些看起来很小的步骤也要有习惯。I would prefer help finding the official location, not someone taking over my whole filing system or sending another loose copy for me to lose.

That distinction is clear. Navigation assistance can stay focused on where the bank makes the correspondence available. Your private filing arrangements are yours. We do not need to reorganise them here. For any follow-up about access, it would be useful to describe the screen you are on without sending passwords or other access credentials to anyone.

Yes, I can keep the question limited to the screen and the document location. 我也不想把家里的电脑交给别人远程弄来弄去，弄好了自己还是不知道怎么找。That can be a separate administrative conversation. For the moment, I have everything I need in front of me, and I would rather finish what I was saying than open the computer and lose my place again.

Then leave the computer closed. The access question can remain separate from this discussion. You have your page in front of you, and I am listening. There is no need to explain your filing arrangements any further before returning to what you wanted to say.
The quantity I want to transact is 250 units. My instruction is to sell, reducing my existing holding. Please place this as a market order.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 250 units of Summit Global Equity ETF using a market order, with a transaction amount of 2,500,000 in Japanese yen. Is that the instruction you authorise me to carry out?
Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it, and I authorise you to carry it out.

Thank you. Before we finish the call, we can deal with the arrangements for future conversations that we left aside earlier. This is about how you would like us to contact you and structure the discussion. Would a short outline in advance help you prepare, or would you prefer to bring your own questions without receiving an agenda?

A short outline would help, as long as it really is short. 不用写得像开会材料那么正式，也不用把每个可能的话题都放进去。看到一大份资料，我会觉得必须先做功课，结果还没通话就累了。I would like to know the broad subjects so I can put the relevant papers nearby, but I don't want the outline to become another notebook that I have to reconcile with my own.

We can keep the preparation focused on broad subjects and practical documents, rather than sending a long set of prompts. If you have a particular question, you can raise it when arranging the call. It also helps to distinguish an administrative query from a discussion that needs proper uninterrupted time, so that the arrangements reflect the kind of conversation you actually want.

That distinction matters to me. If all I need is help locating a letter, I don't need a full portfolio appointment. 反过来，如果有事情想好好谈，就不要把它塞进一个本来只是处理文件的电话里。我以前总说顺便问一下，问着问着就讲很久，大家原来的安排都乱了。Now I would rather say at the beginning whether I am looking for a practical answer or a longer conversation.

That will make the arrangements easier. A practical access question can be directed to the appropriate service, while a longer discussion can be arranged with room for your notes and questions. You do not have to decide every subject when the appointment is made, but it is helpful to know whether you expect a brief administrative exchange or an unhurried conversation.

For longer conversations, I prefer to be at home. I can spread the papers out and close the door. 在外面接电话，哪怕地方很安静，心里还是会想着等会儿要走，或者有人会不会听见。以前我觉得随时能接电话是方便，现在觉得真正方便，是可以专心把一件事说完。If I am travelling, I'd rather arrange a suitable time than try to fit the conversation into a hotel lobby or a car journey.

We can bear that in mind when discussing availability. You can also tell us if a proposed time no longer suits your location or privacy. It is better to make a fresh arrangement than to begin a detailed conversation while you are distracted. Would you prefer the appointment message to make clear that you should have your own notes nearby?

A gentle reminder is useful. Just don't make it sound like a list of homework. 我不是不愿意准备，只是不想又回到以前每次开会前，把所有资料都摊出来检查的习惯。Sometimes I have a question written on a loose sheet rather than in the notebook, and a reminder would prompt me to bring that sheet into the study. That would be enough.

A practical reminder, rather than a preparation pack. That is helpful. We can also leave room at the beginning for you to say whether you have the papers you need. If something is missing, the conversation does not have to turn into a search through drawers or email folders. It can remain focused on what you actually have available.

Good. The searching is what makes me lose the thread. 找着找着，会看到别的信，又想起另外一件事，原来准备问的问题反而忘记了。My wife says I can turn opening a drawer into an afternoon project. She's not entirely wrong. I used to blame the office for that sort of interruption, but apparently I am quite capable of providing the interruptions myself.

At least you recognise what pulls the conversation away from the original subject. We can keep our part straightforward and avoid adding unnecessary material. You mentioned earlier that you no longer want every free morning filled with appointments. Are there parts of your home routine that you would generally prefer us not to interrupt when we are discussing possible times?

I like to leave the beginning of the day open if I can. 我会先到花园里看看，不一定做很多事，有时候只是看看昨晚下雨以后盆里的情况。以前一起来就看电话，心里马上装满别人的事情。现在先出去走一圈，再回来吃东西，整个人比较像是在过自己的日子。Later, when I sit down in the study, I am much more available for a proper conversation.

Then we can ask about a time that fits after you have settled into the day, rather than assuming that the earliest opening is the best one. You mentioned the garden at the beginning of the call as well. Has that become a regular interest since you have been spending less time at the business, or was it something you already enjoyed?

I enjoyed it before, but I was mostly the person who admired the result at the weekend. Now I notice what happens between the tidy stages. 一盆东西看着没什么变化，过些日子又冒出新的叶子。有的地方刚收拾好，一下雨又乱了。以前我会嫌麻烦，现在觉得这种事情不用马上解决，也挺好。There is someone who helps with the heavier work, so I can enjoy it without pretending that I suddenly know everything about plants.

That sounds like a different rhythm from running a distribution business. You can spend time outside without needing to turn it into another responsibility. Do the weekends still feel distinct now that you are not following the old office routine, or have the quieter activities spread more naturally through the week?

The activities have spread out, but weekends still feel different because the family is around. 平日花园很安静，周末有人来，椅子挪来挪去，东西也不会放回原位。我以前会忍不住收拾，现在尽量等大家走了再说。I like hearing people in the house, even if it means the newspaper ends up somewhere unexpected. Quiet is enjoyable because it is not the only thing we have.

That is a nice distinction. We can keep future arrangements separate from those family routines rather than treating your whole calendar as open. And if travel plans change your availability, you can simply tell us when arranging the conversation. There is no need to provide a detailed itinerary for an ordinary appointment.

That is reassuring from a practical point of view. I don't always know exactly what we will do when we travel now. 有时候只是想去住着，天气好就出去，天气不好就在附近喝茶，不会事先把每天排得很满。I can tell you when I expect to be back and settled, without trying to fit a banking call around every possible outing. That feels more sensible than promising I will be available wherever I happen to be.

We can work with that approach to appointments. The important administrative point is to arrange a setting in which you can speak privately and have the relevant material available. Beyond that, your travel plans can remain your own. Is there anything about the format of today's call that you would want handled differently next time?

The pauses were useful. I wouldn't want every conversation to be this long, but today I needed the space. 还有，我说中文的时候，不一定是在找英文怎么讲，有些心里的话用中文比较自然。工作上的事情我习惯用英文，讲到自己的感受，就会换过来。I don't need the conversation to stay in a particular language as long as we can keep the thread and I don't have to make every sentence sound like a business presentation.
您可以按自己自然的方式表达，不用为了通话把每句话都改成同一种语言。以后安排较长的讨论，也可以预留停下来翻看笔记的空间。For the practical arrangements, we can keep the outline brief and let you bring the questions that matter to you at the time.

That's what I would prefer. 陈慧琳，谢谢您留时间让我把话说完整。我知道自己有时候讲得绕，尤其是手边放着很多旧笔记的时候。今天至少没有一边讲电话一边找文件，也没有想着赶回办公室。I'll leave the administrative navigation question for a separate conversation, when I am actually sitting at the computer rather than trying to remember the screen.

That will be a more practical setting for the navigation question. Use the bank's established contact channel when you are ready to raise it, and keep it focused on the document location you are trying to find. We have also covered your preferences for arranging future discussions, so there is no need to settle another appointment while you are still putting today's papers away.

No, I would rather leave the calendar alone for now. 我等会儿把桌面收好，就出去看看外面。刚才听见有人搬花盆，可能是把挡路的东西挪开了。我不急着过去指挥，免得又变成我站在旁边问东问西。It's a pleasant afternoon here, and I think I have spent enough of it sitting in the study. Thank you for the conversation, Rachel.
You're welcome, Mr Lim. Thank you for taking the time to speak with me and for explaining how you prefer to handle the arrangements. I will let you get back to your afternoon. Goodbye.
Goodbye, Rachel. 下次再谈。
